info.title: API.SH: Movoto
info.description: The Movoto API from API.SH: public Movoto data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Places that match typed text on Movoto: cities, ZIP codes, neighborhoods and counties, each with type, name, city, county, state, ZIP, location (use it in /movoto/v1/search), link, homes for sale and coordinates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/movoto-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Housing market numbers for a city, neighborhood, county or ZIP on Movoto: median list price, price per sq ft, size, days on market, inventory and distressed share by property type (all, house, condo...), today, a month ago and a year ago with changes. Places other than a ZIP also get the area summary (average/min/max list price, counts of new, open-house, reduced, pool and new-construction homes), trend summary, listing counts and the top ZIP codes, neighborhoods, nearby cities and counties.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/movoto-market

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A ZIP code (78704), a Movoto path such as austin-tx or travis-county-tx, a movoto.com link, or a place name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One home on Movoto: ids, status, price, sold price, beds, baths, size, lot, year built, garage, HOA, property type, dates, address and coordinates, description, MLS features (interior, exterior, utilities, HOA, taxes...), every photo, price history, value estimate with range, the listing agent and office, nearby schools with levels and ratings, school districts, local scores (walk, food, pets, kids), city market table, nearby homes for sale, sold, new and for rent, FAQs and `raw`. `latest=true` takes the first result of a search instead of a link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/movoto-property

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A movoto.com home link (or its path, as in path of a search result).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Or the path of a search result.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Use the first result of a search (pass the search params, e.g. location).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes for sale, sold homes or rentals in the US on Movoto, with the site's filters: property types, price, beds, baths, size, lot size, year built, days on market, HOA, open houses, new listings, price reduced, virtual tours, new construction, foreclosures, pool, waterfront, garage and photos, plus sort. Each result has ids, link, status, price, sold price, price change, beds, baths, size, lot, year built, garage, HOA fee, property type, listed and sold dates, days on the site, address, neighborhood, coordinates, photo, open houses, virtual tour, MLS number, the listing agent and office (name and office phone) and `raw`. The response also has the area's market summary. 50 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Sold searches show the most recent sales only (about 20).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/movoto-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, ZIP, neighborhood or county: a Movoto path such as austin-tx, tx/78704, austin-tx/zilker or travis-county-tx (as in location of /movoto/v1/autocomplete), a movoto.com search link, or a name or ZIP such as "Austin, TX" or 78704.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Property types, comma list: single_family, condo, multi_family, land, mobile, other.

parameters.name: year_built_min
parameters.description: Built in or after this year.

parameters.name: year_built_max
parameters.description: Built in or before this year.

parameters.name: hoa_max
parameters.description: Maximum monthly HOA fee (USD; 0 = no HOA).

parameters.name: open_house
parameters.description: Only homes with an open house.

parameters.name: new_days
parameters.description: Only homes listed within this many days (1 to 365).

parameters.name: price_reduced_days
parameters.description: Only homes whose price dropped within this many days (1 to 365).

parameters.name: virtual_tour
parameters.description: Only homes with a virtual tour.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
